name: Corona Lorenzo Manuel Berho
current_role: Co-founder and Chairman of the Board, Corporación Inmobiliaria Vesta (Vesta Real Estate Corp., BMV/NYSE: VTMX)
profile: Lorenzo Berho Corona co-founded Vesta in 1998, a Mexican developer and owner of industrial parks and build-to-suit logistics facilities. He chairs the board while his son Lorenzo Dominique Berho Carranza is CEO (since 2018). Vesta listed on the NYSE in 2023 and is riding nearshoring demand in Mexico.
interesting_fact: Vesta debuted on the New York Stock Exchange in 2023 and accelerated a US$1.1bn development pipeline to finish two years early because of nearshoring demand.
notes: Do not confuse with son Lorenzo Berho Carranza (Vesta CEO). Aggregator profiles say he led the Mexican industrial parks association AMPIP (2007-09) and chaired YPO's real estate network, but I did not verify these from primary sources. Best route: Vesta IR.

name: Erez Shachar
current_role: Co-founder & Managing Partner, Qumra Capital (Tel Aviv); director of Taboola, Riskified and Talkspace
profile: Israeli venture investor who co-founded growth-stage fund Qumra Capital (c. 2013) after running Evergreen Venture Partners as managing partner from 2004. He was earlier CEO of NUR Macroprinters. His wealth is tied to stakes and board seats in Israeli tech names such as Taboola, Fiverr, Riskified and Talkspace.
interesting_fact: He has sat on Riskified's board since July 2015, years before its 2021 NYSE IPO, and has been on the boards of several Israeli tech IPOs incl. Taboola, Fiverr and Talkspace.
deep_cut_fact: Before becoming a VC he was CEO and President of NUR Macroprinters, an Israeli maker of wide-format digital printing presses.
notes: Low public profile; best route is Qumra Capital's general inbox. Deep-cut source is a secondary aggregator (theorg) - verify before citing.

name: Neetu Menda
current_role: Director, RMZ Corp Holdings Pvt Ltd and RMZ Realtors Pvt Ltd (Bengaluru)
profile: Neetu (Raj) Menda is a member of the Menda family behind RMZ Corp, the Bengaluru commercial real-estate and infrastructure group founded in 2002 by Arjun Menda and sons Raj and Manoj Menda. Corporate registry data lists her as a director of RMZ group holding entities; she has no public executive role.
interesting_fact: RMZ's governing Supervisory Board is made up entirely of Menda family members (Raj, Manoj, Sidharth, Mihir and Kunal Menda).
notes: Very private; virtually no public profile. Registry names her 'Neetu Raj Menda' (likely Raj Menda's family) - relationship not confirmed. Best route is via RMZ corporate (contact@rmz.com).

name: Sheng Guofu
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder, Hongda High-Tech Holding Co. (宏达高科, SZSE: 002144), formerly Zhejiang Hongda Warp Knitting, Haining
profile: Shen/Sheng Guofu (沈国甫) has run the Haining Xucun warp-knitting factory since 1985, converted it into Zhejiang Hongda Warp Knitting in 1997 and has chaired the listed successor, Hongda High-Tech, since 2001. The company remains a leading warp-knit fabric maker and has added a medical-device business.
interesting_fact: He has led the same business for 40 years - from factory director of the Xucun warp-knitting plant in 1985 to chairman of the listed company - and still chaired its board meetings in 2026.
deep_cut_fact: He served as president of the Zhejiang Warp Knitting Industry Association (浙江省经编行业协会).
notes: Name in company filings is 沈国甫 (Shen Guofu). mqq@ is the board secretary (Ma Qiangqiang) per 2026 filing. Chinese-language outreach advised. Deep-cut source is the 2020 SZSE filing with his resume - verify page.

name: Prahlad Rai Agarwal
current_role: Chairman (Executive Chairman & Whole-time Director), Rupa & Company Ltd, Kolkata
profile: Prahlad Rai Agarwala (b. 1938, Shekhawati) co-founded the Rupa knitwear brand in 1968 with brothers Ghanshyam Prasad and Kunj Bihari Agarwal; Rupa grew into one of India's largest innerwear and hosiery makers and exporters. He has chaired Rupa & Company since 1985; the family promoter group owns about 74%.
interesting_fact: He received the Padma Shri in 2022 for trade and industry, cited as a 'flag bearer of Make in India'.
deep_cut_fact: His first venture, Binod Hosiery, set up in 1962, failed before he co-founded Rupa six years later; he also trained in law (LLB, University of Calcutta) and is Honorary Consul of Colombia in Kolkata.
notes: Aged 88; missed the 41st AGM (Kunj Bihari Agarwal presided). Best route is company secretary / IR in Kolkata.

name: Chun K Hong
current_role: President, CEO and Chairman, Netlist, Inc. (Irvine, CA)
profile: Chun K. 'Chuck' Hong co-founded memory-module maker Netlist in 2000 and took it public in 2006; he is chairman and CEO. After 15 years at LG Electronics/LG Semicon and a stint at Viking, he built Netlist into a high-performance memory and IP company that won large patent verdicts against Samsung and Micron; Q2 2026 sales rose 163% year on year.
interesting_fact: Netlist secured a $303M jury verdict against Samsung (2023) for infringing its memory-module patents, after the two had once signed a joint development agreement in 2015.
deep_cut_fact: Hong writes guest commentary on US patent policy for IPWatchdog, arguing for stronger protection of small inventors; before Netlist he spent 15 years (1983-98) in management at LG in Korea and the US.

public_contacts.value: Mike Smargiassi, The Plunkett Group (investors/media) - NLST@theplunkettgroup.com

notes: Best route: The Plunkett Group (Netlist's IR/media agency). Data-center angle: Netlist sells HBM/DDR5 server memory modules and is heavily focused on AI server memory IP.

name: David E Flitman
current_role: Chair of the Board and CEO, US Foods Holding Corp.; director, Avery Dennison
profile: Dave Flitman has been CEO of US Foods since January 2023 and added the board chair role in May 2026. A Purdue chemical engineer, he spent ~20 years at DuPont, then ran Allegheny Power, held senior roles at Nalco and Univar, and was CEO of Performance Foodservice, BMC Stock Holdings and Builders FirstSource.
interesting_fact: He has run businesses in four different industries: chemicals (DuPont, Nalco, Univar), electric utilities (Allegheny Power), building products (BMC, Builders FirstSource) and foodservice distribution (Performance Foodservice, US Foods).
deep_cut_fact: Energy credentials: from February 2005 to July 2008 he was President of Allegheny Power, the electric utility, after nearly 20 years at DuPont where he started his career.
notes: Utility background (Allegheny Power) is a natural hook for an energy podcast. Route via US Foods media relations.

name: Mehmet Öz
current_role: Administrator, Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), US Dept. of Health and Human Services (since April 2025)
profile: Cardiothoracic surgeon and TV host ('The Dr. Oz Show') who co-founded digital-health company Sharecare with Jeff Arnold in 2010. After a 2022 US Senate run in Pennsylvania, he was confirmed 53-45 as CMS Administrator in April 2025, where he oversees Medicare/Medicaid and is pushing AI and anti-fraud efforts.
interesting_fact: Before TV fame he helped develop heart devices and procedures including the MitraClip and LVAD work, and held several heart-surgery patents.
deep_cut_fact: At Harvard he was a varsity water polo goalkeeper and played safety on the football team, winning the Captain's Athletic Award for leadership; he later earned an MD from Penn and an MBA from Wharton, and was student body president in med school.
notes: Sitting federal official: podcast requests must go through CMS Office of Communications (media inquiries form, media line 202-690-6145 per CMS press page). Ethics rules may limit discussion of Sharecare.

name: William B. Cyr
current_role: CEO, Freshpet, Inc. (since Sept 2016); director, Vital Farms
profile: Billy Cyr spent ~19 years at Procter & Gamble, then led the buyout of Sunny Delight from P&G with J.W. Childs and ran it as CEO for over a decade. Since 2016 he has run Freshpet, the refrigerated fresh pet-food maker, taking it from about $6 a share to a ~$1bn+ revenue business; it marked its 20th anniversary in October 2026.
interesting_fact: As CEO he led the leveraged buyout of Sunny Delight Beverages from P&G and ran it for 11+ years, roughly tripling profits in the first five years.
deep_cut_fact: A 1981 Palmerton (PA) Area High grad, he ran a campus newspaper-distribution business at Princeton with 15 workers that by senior year earned as much as a year's tuition; he likes to note his first-grade report card had a 'C' in writing and numbers.
notes: Princeton '85 (History/East Asian Studies). Freshpet runs 'Freshpet Kitchens' plants and has publicised renewable-energy sourcing - possible energy angle.

name: Einar Roosileht
current_role: Former Chief Information Officer, Rush Street Interactive (stepped down end of 2025 under a planned transition)
profile: Estonian technologist who was CIO of online casino/sportsbook operator Rush Street Interactive (BetRivers) from 2013, building its platform largely from Tallinn. Previously chief architect at Playtech Estonia and founder/CTO of iGaming supplier Oryx Gaming. RSI announced in Jan 2025 that his role would end by year-end 2025.
interesting_fact: RSI's 8-K said his CIO role would end by end-2025 or on completion of a successor's transition, 'not a result of any disagreement' with the company.
deep_cut_fact: Before RSI he founded and was CTO of Oryx Gaming (c. 2010), a turnkey iGaming/sportsbook platform supplier, after serving as chief architect at Playtech's Estonian arm; he studied at the University of Tartu.
notes: Low profile; likely no longer at RSI, so company contacts may not reach him. Deep-cut source is an aggregator (MarketScreener) - verify. Unlikely UHNW.

name: Scott Dietzen
current_role: CEO, Augment Code (AI coding); director (former chairman/CEO), Everpure (formerly Pure Storage)
profile: Carnegie Mellon PhD in computer science who co-founded or helped build Transarc, WebLogic (CTO of BEA after its acquisition) and Zimbra (sold to Yahoo). As CEO of Pure Storage 2010-2017 he took the all-flash storage company through its 2015 IPO, then served as chairman. Since 2023 he has led Augment Code, an enterprise AI coding-agent company.
interesting_fact: He took Pure Storage (now Everpure), a key supplier of flash storage for data centers, from startup to its 2015 IPO as CEO.
deep_cut_fact: He did all three degrees at Carnegie Mellon (BS applied math/CS, MS and PhD in CS with a machine-learning emphasis) - decades before applying ML to code at Augment.

public_contacts.value: Frequent podcast guest, e.g. 'What the futr' ep. 2

notes: Very podcast-friendly (many recent appearances). Data-center angle via Pure/Everpure storage. One source calls him Augment executive chairman - confirm title. No published direct email found.
